notes.title: Dead Reset OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p][i]Dead Reset[/i] is an interactive horror where death is not the end, but the key to survival. Guide Cole Mason, a surgeon trapped in a [b]deadly loop[/b], through moral choices, eerie encounters, and fractured alliances. Each choice steers your fate as death unlocks new paths. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="UR8jIHIJIF4;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p][b]Death is Inevitable [/b][/p][p]Master the death-loop to uncover the path to escape. Death is not the end but offers a terrifying new perspective. [/p][p][/p][p][b]Embrace the Horror [/b][/p][p]Immerse yourself in a blood-soaked, interactive narrative with cinematic scares, bloody practical effects and high-stakes choice-driven gameplay that put you at the heart of a relentless sci-fi horror movie.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Choices Matter [/b][/p][p]Steer Cole on a path of Redemption or Damnation in your fight to survive. There are no easy choices as your morality is tested at every turn and your decisions will result in four wildly different endings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Pause the Terror [/b][/p][p]Playing to an audience? Enable Streamer Mode, which removes time constraints on choices, letting your viewers guide Cole’s fate and delight in his gruesome deaths.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Who Do You Trust? [/b][/p][p]Build trust or fracture alliances; each bond forged or broken influences your road to survival. View the in-game tracker to check your relationship with other characters, if they are still alive.[/p][p][/p][p][b]A message from the film director, Stewart Sparke...[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]"Dead Reset was designed to get under the skin of the player and deliver relentless scares driven by gruesome practical effects and a time-bending descent into terror. I can't wait for people to dive in and play our blood-drenched, interactive love letter to the horror genre!" [/i][/p][p][/p][p]Developed by Wales Interactive and Dark Rift Horror.[/p][p]Published by Wales Interactive[/p][p]Film production by Dark Rift Horror.[/p]

notes.title: An FMV crime-mystery with 4K video, free demo available!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2521410/The_Isle_Tide_Hotel__4K_Video_Pack/

The Isle Tide Hotel has undergone some "renovations". Our latest patch includes some minor optimisations, bug fixes and subtitle adjustments.

Experience the enigmatic world of The Isle Tide Hotel like never before with 4K video content. Immerse yourself in the intrigue of this FMV detective game with stunning visuals that bring the mysterious hotel and its cast to life in exquisite detail. Uncover the secrets and solve the puzzles in unparalleled clarity as you strive to save your missing daughter.

Not only that, you can also play a free demo for The Isle Tide Hotel!

What is The Isle Tide Hotel? Think a British Twin Peaks with a Wes Anderson aesthetic! Or, if that doesn't convince you, how about a grittier Knives Out? There's so much to explore and discover about The Isle Tide Hotel that one playthrough won't get close to telling the whole story.

[previewyoutube=_lSv_RQkKi8;full][/previewyoutube]

Why is your daughter estranged in the first place? Will you join the cult to save her? How will you interact with the bizarre people you meet? Each playthrough of The Isle Tide Hotel's branching narrative will be completely different, with seven main endings in your mission to rescue the daughter you've never met. Just remember… don't break the Etiquettes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/9c782eeaef7589cd09a03a1731c10d20a6bd524d.jpg[/img]

Created by brother-sister director-producer combo Harry and Grace Chadwick of Interflix Media, the themes of The Isle Tide Hotel draw on the transformational journey of parenthood and the unique paths that can be taken when dealing with family dynamics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/0c5302aecad1055167a43dac51c405e601a451b2.jpg[/img]

You don't want to miss our biggest production yet, with a cast including UK icons from shows including Game of Thrones, Call the Midwife and Happy Valley. Every decision affects the story and you'll have to keep an eye out for clues - it's on you if you miss something important.

notes.title: Meet The Cast & Crew | The Isle Tide Hotel
notes.notes:
Welcome back to The Isle Tide Hotel, we hope you enjoyed our previous update that provided an insight into what it was like filming on location. Now let us take a glance at just some of the incredible cast and crew.

[h3]Harry Chadwick - Writer & Director  |  Grace Chadwick - Producer[/h3]

Harry and Grace Chadwick, the founders of [url=https://www.interflixmedia.com/our-games-films]Interflix Media[/url] have over twenty years combined experience working in the film industry, with their first film being recognised by the Oscars. Their other works include: [b]Survive The Night[/b] an interactive, 180° series, shot in 4K 3D and [b]Pardon The Intrusion[/b],  a film exploring age, personal courage and interconnection that won four Best Short Film Awards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/685ad2ac1a243330d7e16173c692e345cd3be69b.png[/img]

[h3] Michael D Xavier - Josh Malone [/h3]

Michael D Xavier plays our protagonist Josh Malone who is searching for his daughter Eleanor. He is internationally known for his roles in hit TV shows such as Gentleman Jack, Outlander, The Blacklist and Grantchester. 

[h3] Jemima Rooper - R. Price [/h3]

Jemima Rooper plays the passionate and determined R. Price, Private Investigator. Jemima is both a star on stage and screen, and recognised for her roles in The Black Dahlia, Lost in Austen, As If and BBC's Atlantis. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/ea2bea9ddeb8d7551454a191e998b1dbdf607eba.png[/img]

[h3]Richard Brake - The Receptionist [/h3]

Richard Brake plays the Receptionist who you may have already met in The Isle Tide Hotel Demo. Richard Brake is famously known for his roles in Game of Thrones, Doom, 31 and Kingsman: Secret Service, to name just a few! 

[h3]Georgie Glen - Dr. Aniston [/h3]

Georgie Glen plays the mysterious Dr. Aniston. Georgie Glen has a plethora of roles in many of the most iconic British TV Shows such as Call The Midwife, Waterloo Road and The Crown as well as hit films such as Calendar Girls and Jackie. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/45c188647708283a5ccda5093740c81020a655c2.png[/img]

That was just a glimpse of the amazing cast and crew of The Isle Tide Hotel, let us know in the comments who you are looking forward to seeing the most when the game launches this [b]September 12th[/b] on PC, mobile and all gaming consoles!

notes.title: Welcome to The Isle Tide Hotel
notes.notes:
[h3]About Us[/h3]

Welcome to The Isle Tide Hotel, we offer a range of options to suit the needs of all of our patrons. At The Isle Tide Hotel, we pride ourselves on ensuring that everybody has a memorable stay and indulges in all that we have to offer. Located in the heart of the countryside we give peace of mind to all those who join us after their term.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/fabc7a61d830b3cb96027c1226730715fde39fd1.png[/img]

[h3]Our Rooms[/h3]

Our specially prepared rooms come with everything you could need to enjoy the Swell Celebration. 

✔ View overlooking countryside
✔ Tea, Coffee & Biscuits 
✔ Fluffy Towels
✔ A luxurious bath
✔ Provided with iron, hangers and hair dryer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/7199866b874a266033371edebdaa8505fe33a80d.png[/img]

[h3]Behind The Scenes[/h3]

We spoke with [b]Writer & Director Harry Chadwick and Producer Grace Chadwick [/b] from Interflix Media about what it was like filming The Isle Tide Hotel on such a beautiful location, which they scouted due to a family occassion being hosted there! Despite it being early in the pre-production process, Harry and Grace knew that this location had to be The Isle Tide Hotel. 

Filming on location was completed in just three weeks with a cast and crew of 90, which meant they had to work hard and fast, filming on average [b]20-30 pages[/b] of script per day. However, Richard Brake who plays the ever so mysterious Receptionist had to film 26 pages in one day to fit it into his schedule. 

Not only that, but over 300 children were also on location as the shoot had to be scheduled during the same period as a Summer Camp! Many of The Isle Tide Hotel outtakes feature: [b]"CUT - Kids in the Background!" [/b]

There are so many places waiting for you to explore in The Isle Tide Hotel. For those who have experienced the tantilising demo, the hotel bar is in fact built [b]entirely from scratch[/b]! The Head of Construction did an amazing job to ensure the custom bar and shelving tied in with the ceiling and the 1920s feel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/d4740bbd66ee531a6cfcabdbb84ae9a2ed8a3a13.png[/img]


We hope you had a pleasant visit in this peek behind the scenes of The Isle Tide Hotel. We will be sharing more over the next coming weeks, so pack a bag and join us as we head toward the exciting release of The Isle Tide Hotel this September.

notes.title: Check out the Trailer for the live-action interactive mystery!
notes.notes:
Wales Interactive and Interflix Media are proud to announce The Isle Tide Hotel, a live-action interactive mystery where an absent father must rescue his teenage daughter from an eclectic cult before their final night at the Isle Tide Hotel.

Players investigate the strange events that unfold to save Eleanor Malone in this live-action interactive mystery game, where every decision affects the story. 

[previewyoutube=5G5ey-9KQCQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Story[/h2]
Open every three years for three nights, a strange mix of colourful characters hiding personal traumas gather to uncover the one thread binding them. Their search for the meaning of life. But tonight, this mysterious organisation must decide whether to break their own etiquettes and hand over a teenage girl to their elusive founder, Dr. Aniston, who promises her sacrifice will conclude their purpose.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/a59eb786b5c4cf1285589db297e8668aeb4228a6.jpg[/img]

How do you infiltrate the hotel? Will you coax your way into the cult? Do you discover the hidden lore, side quests and their dedicated endings or fail at any one of the ruthless narrative puzzles? Navigate a branching narrative with numerous ways to help rescue the daughter you’ve never met.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/9c782eeaef7589cd09a03a1731c10d20a6bd524d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Main Features [/h2]
A live action game which responds to your choices 
7 main endings available with 14 different outcomes 
Side quests which have dedicated endings 
Real-time personality and cult association tracker 
In-game chapter skip menu - but you have to earn it first 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43208645/0c5302aecad1055167a43dac51c405e601a451b2.jpg[/img]

[h2]Narrative Features [/h2]
A unique cult with its own rich history and rules 
Paths blocked behind information 
Cryptic notes to hidden endings 
Hidden lore and ‘Easter eggs’ to discover 
Sprawling dialogue options that make you see the same character in a different light
